title: Guidance Note: Fee Waivers on PracticePay Patient Financing Plans
content:
A late fee or returned-payment fee on a PracticePay Patient Financing plan can be waived on several bases. The note below sets out each basis as the policy states it.

**Once per fee.** A late or returned-payment fee may be waived once: a fee entry that already carries a waiver entry is not waived again.

**Courtesy waiver count — clause no longer in force.** The clause that a courtesy waiver is granted on request when fewer than the plan's courtesy waivers per 12 months have been granted on the plan is no longer in force as written; it is superseded by the current make-up relief terms of PracticePay Patient Financing. The per-plan number of courtesy waivers itself stays as the fee schedule states it.

**Courtesy request window (in force).** A courtesy waiver must be requested no later than the fee waiver request window after the fee's assessment date. The window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the fee's assessment date, and a request on the last day is in time.

| Request made on (counting from the day after the fee's assessment date) | In time |
|---|---|
| the 45th calendar day | yes |
| the 46th calendar day | no |

**Bases without a window or a count.** Fees caused by a Larkspur error, a debit confirmed as unauthorized, or a bank error documented by the bank are waived on those bases without a window or count; fees caused by a disputed amount are waived on the dispute-resolved basis when the dispute is resolved with a provider credit.

**Full provider refund.** When a full provider refund cancels the plan, every interest and fee line still owed is waived on the provider-full-refund basis.

## Bases at a glance

| Basis | Applies to | Window and count |
|---|---|---|
| courtesy | a late or returned-payment fee, on request | requested within the fee waiver request window after the assessment date |
| Larkspur error | fees caused by a Larkspur error | no window and no count |
| unauthorized debit | fees caused by a debit confirmed as unauthorized | no window and no count |
| documented bank error | fees caused by a bank error documented by the bank | no window and no count |
| dispute resolved | fees caused by a disputed amount, when the dispute is resolved with a provider credit | — |
| full provider refund | every interest and fee line still owed when a full provider refund cancels the plan | — |

superseded_clauses: A courtesy waiver is granted on request when fewer than the plan's courtesy waivers per 12 months have been granted on the plan.
